parsing_traps.trap: No Portfolio Statement in the standard sense
parsing_traps.detail: locate.py found no 'Portfolio Statement' anchor. The equivalent disclosure is the 'Statement of Portfolio' on pages 164-166 which shows per-property SGD carrying values. Used factsheet pages 28-46 for JPY valuations and property details, cross-checked with portfolio overview table pp26-27 for GR/NPI in JPY millions.

parsing_traps.trap: Statement of Portfolio parser row scrambling
parsing_traps.detail: The Statement of Portfolio table (p164) has parser-scrambled region/description assignments. For example: DPL Shinfuji is mapped to 'Greater Tokyo' (actual: Greater Nagoya); D Project Tan Duc 2 is mapped to 'Shikoku' (actual: Vietnam); DPL Gunma Fujioka shows 'Vietnam Long An' as description. These are clearly parser artifacts — the region names appear to be shifted relative to property names. Used factsheet pages as authoritative source for country/region, addresses, and tenure.

parsing_traps.trap: Dual-basis NPI figure for D Project Tan Duc 2
parsing_traps.detail: Portfolio overview table p26 shows NPI for Vietnam property as 'VND 46,886' millions. Operating segments p193 shows Vietnam NPI = SGD 2,357k. Both are correct at their respective bases (VND is local currency from portfolio overview table; SGD is consolidated reporting currency from audited segment note). Stored VND figure in properties.json with explicit npi_currency=VND field.

parsing_traps.trap: GR column for single-tenanted properties shows dash '–'
parsing_traps.detail: Portfolio overview table pp26-27 shows '–' for 11 BTS/single-tenanted properties. Footnote 3 explicitly states GR not disclosed due to confidentiality. Only NPI disclosed for these properties (in JPY from the NPI column, currency header says '(millions)'). Stored as null gross_revenue with explanation.

parsing_traps.trap: Portfolio overview table duplicated across pages 26-27
parsing_traps.detail: Pages 26 and 27 contain identical portfolio overview tables. Both verified to have the same values. Used page 26 as primary source.

Distribution statement p163: opening balance 16,547k + net income 34,881k + distribution adjustments -4,503k = Income available 30,378k. Total amount available incl. opening = 46,925k. Headline distributable income = 30,378k (income for FY2025). Used 30,378k as net_distributable_income in performance.json.

parsing_traps.trap: Investment properties carrying value vs portfolio valuation
parsing_traps.detail: Balance sheet shows S$984,117k carrying value. Portfolio Statement shows S$835,157k at valuation. Difference of S$148,960k = right-of-use assets (S$133,125k) + asset retirement obligation (S$15,835k) per the reconciliation table on p166. performance.json uses S$835.2m (rounded) as portfolio_value per headlined figure.

reconciliation.reconciliation_note_gr: PARTIAL DISCLOSURE: Only 7 of 18 Japan properties disclose GR (multi-tenanted only; BTS suppressed by confidentiality per footnote 3 p26). Property GR values stored in JPY absolute; performance.gross_revenue is in SGD. Sum of 7 disclosed Japan GR = JPY 4,267,000,000. These 7 properties are the only ones where GR could be reconciled. Reported Japan GRI p53 = JPY 5,586m (full portfolio incl. undisclosed BTS). No cross-currency reconciliation possible at per-property level. SGD total GR S$57,794k is trust-level consolidated, no per-property SGD breakdown disclosed.
reconciliation.npi_reconciliation_note: Japan NPI: Sum of all 18 Japan property NPI from portfolio overview p26 = JPY 4,789,000,000 vs Japan Portfolio NPI JPY 4,787,000,000 (p53 financial review). Diff = +JPY 2m (0.04%) = rounding in table. Property values stored in JPY absolute. Vietnam NPI stored in VND (46,886,000,000 VND) separately. Total SGD NPI reconciliation: Japan SGD NPI S$41,842k + Vietnam SGD NPI S$2,357k = S$44,199k = exactly matches audited total NPI (operating segments p193 and income statement p162). Full reconciliation confirmed.
